title: The Fall of the Guardian
summary: In an emotional retrospective and ceremony of honor, Kang Tae-Jun steps down as the combat Guardian, passing the eternal mantle of planetary protector to Ha-Jun.

panels.shot: the sunlit steps of seoul city hall decorated in ceremonial red carpet
panels.action: The grand granite steps of Seoul City Hall are lined with ceremonial honor guards of both human hunters and demon knights.
panels.prose_en: The grand granite steps of Seoul City Hall are lined with ceremonial honor guards of both human hunters and demon knights.
panels.prose_hi: Seoul city hall ki bhavya granite sidhiyan manav shikariyon aur danav shoorveeron donon ke aupcharik samman rakshakon se susajjit han.

panels.shot: captain baek in full dress uniform saluting as the brothers ascend
panels.action: Supreme General Baek salutes proudly as Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun walk up the steps side by side.

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Present arms! For the Saviors of Earth!

panels.prose_en: Supreme General Baek salutes proudly as Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun walk up the steps side by side.
panels.prose_hi: Jab Ha-Jun aur Tae-Jun sath-sath sidhiyan chadhte hain to supreme general bak garv se salami dete han.

panels.shot: hundreds of swords and rail-rifles raised in synchronized salute
panels.action: Five hundred blades and rifles snap upward in rigid, thundering military synchronization.
panels.prose_en: Five hundred blades and rifles snap upward in rigid, thundering military synchronization.
panels.prose_hi: Panch sau blade aur riflein kathor, gadgdati sainya synchronization mein upar ki or badhti han.

panels.shot: inside the grand auditorium: the world council waiting in silence
panels.action: A thousand diplomats, presidents, and demonic clan patriarchs rise in silence as the brothers enter the hall.
panels.prose_en: A thousand diplomats, presidents, and demonic clan patriarchs rise in silence as the brothers enter the hall.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi bhai hall mein pravesh karte han, ek hajar rajnayik, rashtrapati aur shaitani demonic kul ke mukhiya chupchap khade ho jaate han.

panels.shot: tae-jun walking to the central podium unbuckling his guardian claymore
panels.action: Tae-Jun walks to the central marble podium, unbuckling the heavy bronze sword harness from his chest.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: For seven years, I carried this sword in the dark so my brother could live in the light.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun walks to the central marble podium, unbuckling the heavy bronze sword harness from his chest.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun apni chhati se bhari kansya talwar ki rassi ko kholte hue, kendriya sangmarmar manch ki or chalta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun laying the bronze sword upon the velvet ceremonial table
panels.action: Tae-Jun lays his iconic bronze blade upon a velvet-lined mahogany table, his hands steady and peaceful.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun lays his iconic bronze blade upon a velvet-lined mahogany table, his hands steady and peaceful.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun apne pratishthit kansya blade ko makhamli-rekha wali mahogani mej par rakhta hai, uske haath sthir aur shantipurna han.

panels.shot: close-up on tae-jun hands: calloused, scarred, but now relaxed
panels.action: The deep scars from Project Chimera biopsies are healed; his fingers rest loosely without trembling.

dialogue.text: The long, lonely war of Subject Zero was over.

panels.prose_en: The deep scars from Project Chimera biopsies are healed; his fingers rest loosely without trembling.
panels.prose_hi: Project chimera biopsy se gahre nishan theek ho gaye han; uski ungaliyan bina compen aaram se aaram karti han.

panels.shot: tae-jun turning to face ha-jun with tears of brotherly pride
panels.action: Tae-Jun looks at Ha-Jun, his voice thick with emotion: 'My duty as your shield is finished, Ha-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Tum ab mere chhotey bhai nahi rahe jisko bachane ki zaroorat hai. You are the Sovereign.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun looks at Ha-Jun, his voice thick with emotion: 'My duty as your shield is finished, Ha-Jun.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun Ha-Jun ki or dekhta hai, uski awaz bhavna se bhari hui hai: 'tumhari dhal ke roop mein mera kartavya samapt ho gaya hai, Ha-Jun.'

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping forward gripping tae-jun hands with deep emotion
panels.action: Ha-Jun grips his brother's hands: 'You will always be my shield, Tae-Jun. Not because of a sword, but because of your heart.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tum hamesha mere elder brother rahoge. Nothing can change that.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun grips his brother's hands: 'You will always be my shield, Tae-Jun. Not because of a sword, but because of your heart.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne bhai ka haath pakadta hai: 'tum hamesha meri dhal banoge, Tae-Jun. talwar ki vajah se nahin, balki apne dil ki vajah se.'

panels.shot: the entire assembly erupting into a five-minute standing ovation
panels.action: Diplomats, generals, and demon lords applaud with tears in their eyes, celebrating the brothers' eternal love.
panels.prose_en: Diplomats, generals, and demon lords applaud with tears in their eyes, celebrating the brothers' eternal love.
panels.prose_hi: Rajnayik, senapati aur rakshas shasak bhaiyon ke shashwat prem ka jashn manate hue, aankhon mein aansu bharkar taliyan bajate han.

panels.shot: captain baek presenting tae-jun with the medal of supreme honor
panels.action: General Baek pins the newly forged 'Star of Earth' gold medal onto Tae-Jun's lapel: 'The highest honor of our united world.'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: For the greatest guardian humanity ever produced.

panels.prose_en: General Baek pins the newly forged 'Star of Earth' gold medal onto Tae-Jun's lapel: 'The highest honor of our united world.'.
panels.prose_hi: Janaral bake ne naye bane 'star off arth' swarn padak ko Tae-Jun ke lapel par pin kiya: 'hamari ekjut duniya ka sarvochch samman.'

panels.shot: tae-jun smiling warmly accepting the medal with a dignified bow
panels.action: Tae-Jun bows gracefully: 'I accept this on behalf of all the children who survived the dark.'
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun bows gracefully: 'I accept this on behalf of all the children who survived the dark.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun shalinata se jhukte han: 'main un sabhi bachchon ki or se ise sweekar karta hun jo andhere mein bach gaye.'

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping up to the signing desk to ratify the final accord
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward to the treaty document, dipping his ceremonial pen in golden ink.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps forward to the treaty document, dipping his ceremonial pen in golden ink.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sandhi dastavej ki or aage badhta hai, aur apni aupcharik kalam ko sunhari syahi mein dubata hai.

panels.shot: extreme macro on ha-jun signature: 'Kang Ha-Jun — True Demon Sovereign'
panels.action: With a smooth, elegant stroke, Ha-Jun's name is inscribed into the foundation of global history.
panels.prose_en: With a smooth, elegant stroke, Ha-Jun's name is inscribed into the foundation of global history.
panels.prose_hi: Ek sahaj, sundar stroke ke sath, Ha-Jun ka naam vaishvik itihaas ki neenv mein ankit hai.

panels.shot: golden runic seal radiating from the paper binding both worlds in peace
panels.action: The treaty parchment pulses with golden sovereign mana, locking the planetary wards forever.

dialogue.text: A world where demons and humans walked as brothers was born.

panels.prose_en: The treaty parchment pulses with golden sovereign mana, locking the planetary wards forever.
panels.prose_hi: Sandhi ka charmpatra sunhare samprabhu man ke saath spandit hota hai, jo grahon ke wardon ko hamesha ke liye band kar deta hai.

panels.shot: flash forward: late afternoon in a sunny seoul residential park
panels.action: Late afternoon: golden autumn leaves drift from oak trees in a peaceful Mapo residential park.
panels.prose_en: Late afternoon: golden autumn leaves drift from oak trees in a peaceful Mapo residential park.
panels.prose_hi: Der dopahar: ek shantipurna mapo avasiya park mein oak ke pedon se sunhari sharad ritu ki pattiyan bahti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun walking side by side in casual civilian clothes
panels.action: Ha-Jun wears a comfortable grey hoodie and jeans; Tae-Jun wears a black leather jacket and boots.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun wears a comfortable grey hoodie and jeans; Tae-Jun wears a black leather jacket and boots.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek aaramdayak grey hudi aur jeans pahanta hai; Tae-Jun kale chamde ki jacket aur jute pahanta hai.

panels.shot: kuro hopping along the wooden park bench chasing a falling leaf
panels.action: Little Kuro playfully hops along a green park bench, snapping his beak at a swirling red maple leaf.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: This leaf has offensive aerodynamic properties. I have conquered it.

panels.prose_en: Little Kuro playfully hops along a green park bench, snapping his beak at a swirling red maple leaf.
panels.prose_hi: Chhota Kuro hare park ki bench par chanchaltapurvak uchhal-kud karta hai aur apni chonch se ghumte hue lal maple ke patte ko dekhta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun laughing at kuro antics
panels.action: The brothers laugh in the cool autumn breeze, their faces free of stress and darkness.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kuro, it's just a maple leaf.

panels.prose_en: The brothers laugh in the cool autumn breeze, their faces free of stress and darkness.
panels.prose_hi: Bhai sharad ritu ki thandi hawa mein hanste han, unke chehre tanaav aur andhere se mukt hote han.

panels.shot: tae-jun stopping at a park vending machine buying two ice cream cones
panels.action: Tae-Jun stops at an outdoor ice cream stand, handing Ha-Jun a waffle cone with two scoops of chocolate.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Double chocolate. Your favorite since you were seven.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun stops at an outdoor ice cream stand, handing Ha-Jun a waffle cone with two scoops of chocolate.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ek outdoor icecream stand par rukta hai aur Ha-Jun ko chocolate ke do scoop ke saath ek wafal kon deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes widening as the forgotten childhood memory returns!
panels.action: Ha-Jun takes the cone; a spark of golden starlight flashes in his brain as the sacrificed memory restores itself!

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Namsan Tower... Summer vacation... I remember! The memory came back!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun takes the cone; a spark of golden starlight flashes in his brain as the sacrificed memory restores itself!.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun shanku leta hai; jaise hi balidan ki gai smriti punah sthapit hoti hai, uske mastishk mein sunhari taron ki roshni ki ek chingari chamakti hai!

panels.shot: ha-jun tears welling up as he remembers his mother's smile clearly
panels.action: In his mind, his mother's smiling face crystallizes in sharp, beautiful 4K clarity: the Hourglass has returned his memories!

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hyung... Mummy ka chehra... Mujhe sab yaad aa gaya!

panels.prose_en: In his mind, his mother's smiling face crystallizes in sharp, beautiful 4K clarity: the Hourglass has returned his memories!.
panels.prose_hi: Uske dimag men, uski maa ka muskurata hua chehra teevra, sundar 4K spashtata mein cristlikrit ho jata hai: ovarglas ne uski yaadein lauta di han!

panels.shot: tae-jun smiling with deep, tearful warmth wrapping arm around ha-jun
panels.action: Tae-Jun hugs him sideways, tears running down his cheeks: 'Because love cannot be erased by time, Ha-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Maine kaha tha na? Jo sach hai wo kabhi nahi mit sakta.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun hugs him sideways, tears running down his cheeks: 'Because love cannot be erased by time, Ha-Jun.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne use bagal mein gale lagaya, uske gaalon par aansu bah rahe the: 'kyonki pyar ko samay se mitaya nahin ja sakta, Ha-Jun.'

panels.shot: kuro landing on ha-jun shoulder pecking a piece of waffle cone
panels.action: Kuro pecks a tiny crumb of waffle: 'Mmm. Sugary. The Sovereign's chef should take notes.'
panels.prose_en: Kuro pecks a tiny crumb of waffle: 'Mmm. Sugary. The Sovereign's chef should take notes.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro wafal ke ek chhote tukde ko chonch maarta hai: 'mamm. mitha. samprabhu ke rasoiye ko note lena chahiye.'

panels.shot: min-jae running into the park waving university graduation cap and gowns
panels.action: Min-Jae runs across the grass carrying two graduation gowns: 'Hey! The registrar office called! We passed our exams!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: We passed calculus!! Graduation ceremony is on Friday!!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae runs across the grass carrying two graduation gowns: 'Hey! The registrar office called! We passed our exams!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je do graduation gown lekar ghas par daudati hai: 'are! registrar karyalay ne bulaya! humne apni pariksha uttirn kar li!'

panels.shot: ha-jun bursting into surprised laughter: 'we passed calculus?!'
panels.action: Ha-Jun laughs out loud: 'Wait, I actually passed without studying?!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Calculus pass ho gaya?! How is that possible?!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun laughs out loud: 'Wait, I actually passed without studying?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun jor se hansta hai: 'ruko, main vaastav mein bina padhe hi paas ho gaya?!'.

panels.shot: min-jae grinning: 'the professor said saving the university gives 100 extra credit points!'
panels.action: Min-Jae winks: 'Professor Park said saving the campus from a 2-mile dreadnought counts as extra credit!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Dreadnought slice karne ke 100 bonus marks mile!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae winks: 'Professor Park said saving the campus from a 2-mile dreadnought counts as extra credit!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je aankh maarte hue kahte han: 'profacer park ne kaha ki parisar ko 2 meal ki bhayavah sthiti se bachana atirikt shrey ke roop mein gina jata hai!'

panels.shot: the group of four friends laughing together under the golden maple trees
panels.action: The four companions laugh together under the golden autumn trees, their shadows stretching long and peaceful.
panels.prose_en: The four companions laugh together under the golden autumn trees, their shadows stretching long and peaceful.
panels.prose_hi: Charon saathi sunhare patjhad ke pedon ke neeche ek saath hanste han, unki chhaya lambi aur shantipurna hoti hai.

panels.shot: sunset over seoul: neon lights turning on under a clean, peaceful sky
panels.action: The sun sets behind Bukhansan mountain; Seoul glows with millions of tranquil, peaceful neon lights.

dialogue.text: The city was safe. The war was won.

panels.prose_en: The sun sets behind Bukhansan mountain; Seoul glows with millions of tranquil, peaceful neon lights.
panels.prose_hi: Suraj bukanson parvat ke peeche dubta hai; seoul lakhon shantipurna nean roshni se jagmagata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up at the first evening star smiling with complete peace cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks up at the first twinkling evening star, his royal violet eyes filled with serenity and readiness for the future.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks up at the first twinkling evening star, his royal violet eyes filled with serenity and readiness for the future.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun pehle timtimate sham ke taare ko dekhta hai, uski shahi baingani aankhen shanti aur bhavishya ke liye tatparta se bhari hoti han.
